stores.name: Woolworths South Bank
stores.address: Woolworths Metro, South Bank Railway Station, 253 Grey St, South Brisbane QLD 4101
stores.notes: Compact but well-stocked supermarket at South Bank station. Perfect for guests at South Bank accommodation.

stores.name: Woolworths Queen Street Mall
stores.address: Queen Adelaide Building, 90 Queen St, Brisbane QLD 4000
stores.notes: CBD supermarket in the Queen Street Mall arcade. Walk from most CBD hotels. Good for quick top-ups.

stores.name: Woolworths Fortitude Valley
stores.notes: Full supermarket for Fortitude Valley. Walk from James Street and Brunswick Street accommodation.

stores.name: Woolworths Ascot (near Hamilton)
stores.address: Racecourse Village, 181 Lancaster Rd, Ascot QLD 4007
stores.notes: Closest full Woolworths to Hamilton/Portside area (~5 min drive). Good for families staying near Eat Street Northshore.

stores.name: Coles South Bank
stores.address: Coles South Bank, 134 Grey St, South Brisbane QLD 4101
stores.notes: Smaller Coles in South Bank precinct. Walk from South Bank hotels. Great for essentials.

stores.name: Coles Myer Centre
stores.address: Myer Centre, Queen St, Brisbane QLD 4000
stores.notes: CBD Coles in the Myer Centre basement. Combined with shopping mall. Walk from Queen Street hotels.

stores.name: Coles Fortitude Valley
stores.address: Valley Metro, 1220 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley QLD 4006
stores.notes: Full Coles in the Valley Metro complex. Good for Fortitude Valley and New Farm families.

stores.name: Coles Indooroopilly
stores.address: Indooroopilly Shopping Centre, 322 Moggill Rd, Indooroopilly QLD 4068
stores.notes: Large Coles in Indooroopilly Shopping Centre. Near Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary area (~10 min drive).

stores.name: ALDI Fortitude Valley
stores.address: ALDI Fortitude Valley, 757 Ann St, Fortitude Valley QLD 4006
stores.notes: Budget supermarket for Fortitude Valley families. Excellent value for essentials.

stores.name: ALDI Woolloongabba (near South Bank)
stores.address: Woolloongabba Central, 785 Stanley St, Woolloongabba QLD 4102
stores.notes: Cheapest grocery option near South Bank. Bring or buy bags. About 5 min drive from South Bank.

stores.name: IGA New Farm
stores.address: IGA New Farm, 145 Merthyr Rd, New Farm QLD 4005
stores.notes: Convenient local IGA near New Farm Park. Good for New Farm and CBD-adjacent families.

stores.name: FoodWorks West End
stores.address: FoodWorks West End, 195 Boundary St, West End QLD 4101
stores.notes: Local supermarket in vibrant West End. Walk from South Bank. Community-focused with good local range.
